name: Can I stay in my home during a room addition construction?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a room addition construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can remain in your home during construction depends largely on the scope and invasiveness of the addition. For smaller, less disruptive projects, like an attached single-room expansion that doesn't affect essential living areas, staying might be feasible. However, projects involving major structural changes, extensive utility shutdowns, or significant dust and noise (e.g., a second-story addition or extensive interior demolition) often necessitate temporary relocation for safety and comfort. We assess your specific project and advise on the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying in your home during a room addition depends on the project's scope. Minor additions might allow it, but major structural work or utility disruptions often require temporary relocation for safety.
